probe_induced_obligations.cause: Historical same-owner stale-epoch probe created workflow.created outbox work and raw-deleted the workflow row; the foreign-key cascade removed the outbox row before the scheduler consumer processed the broker message, which was correctly quarantined as POISON_RECORD.
probe_induced_obligations.workflow_id_mapping: Inferred from retained same-owner probe results and run timestamps. Original Kafka payload bytes were not retained, so the mapping is not direct payload inspection.
probe_induced_obligations.global_open_obligation_set_at_capture: These five historical probe-induced items were open at teardown; the reclassification explains their source and does not represent them as resolved or delete their records.

interpretation: The two cited DUR-049 workflows were terminal with no workflow-scoped open obligations and the database outbox had no pending or claimed rows. Five global poison-record items remained open at teardown and are attributed to historical same-owner stale-epoch negative-control probes, not to the measured recovery workflows. The records remain captured, not resolved; teardown did not dismiss them.
